title: Approaches and limitations of using extractable organofluorine – combustion ion chromatography to assess PFAS Total in drinking water
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, 28,1830-1842
DOI: 10.1039/D6EM00065G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Pontus Larsson, Enmiao Jiao, Anna Kärrman, Patrick van Hees, Patrik Karlsson, Leo W. Y. Yeung
EOF-CIC was evaluated as a proxy for EU “PFAS Total” in drinking water. TFA recovery, fluorine conversion factors, and organofluorine interferences may bias results, highlighting limitations and the need for improved workflows.
